people.name: Israel

translations.web: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.
translations.bsb: I will also meet with the Israelites there, and that place will be consecrated by My glory.
translations.kjv: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.
